content: tower_http::cors::CorsLayer::new().allow_origin(...) accepts anything Into<AllowOrigin>: a single parsed HeaderValue, an array/Vec of HeaderValues for an explicit allowlist of multiple exact origins, or AllowOrigin::predicate(fn) for pattern-based matching (e.g., matching any chrome-extension://* origin without hardcoding one extension ID). Exact-origin arrays are the standard allowlist pattern; predicate is needed if the extension ID is not fixed at deploy time.
